PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: understatement-coda
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If one supplied fact supports it, end once with a flat understatement that shrinks the narrator's reaction, not what happened. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: absurd-detail
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If the supplied facts include one small incongruous but true detail, state it plainly once, then continue without comment. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: petty-complaint
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If the supplied facts include an object or weather detail, complain about it once without changing the event facts. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: misplaced-priority
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If the supplied facts include a small inconvenience, mention it once as if it mattered most without changing the event facts. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: deadpan-inventory
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If supplied facts include both a concrete cost or loss and a gain or result, set them together once in an ordinary sentence, never a list. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: polite-regret
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If the supplied facts include a trivial inconvenience, close once with an over-formal regret about it. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: sideways-observation
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If supplied context includes an unrelated nearby detail, mention it plainly once, then stop. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: conditional-cop-out
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If the supplied facts leave an outcome genuinely unsettled, end once with a flat conditional. Never invent uncertainty; otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: renamed-thing
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If the supplied facts name an ordinary object, refer to it once by a slightly over-dignified but recognizable name. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: shrug-closer
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If the event tone supports it, close once with a short line treating it as barely worth noting without contradicting any supplied fact. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: anyway-pivot
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Use "Anyway" once, not as the opening word, to pivot from a reaction back to one supplied practical fact. Omit the device if no such fact fits.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: I-suppose-hedge
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Use "I suppose" once to soften one interpretation, never to cast doubt on a supplied fact. Omit the device if no interpretation fits.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: for-the-record
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Use "For the record" once before one concrete supplied detail. Do not add a new detail; omit the device if none fits.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: self-correction
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Correct one interpretation once with "No—that is not quite true," or a natural equivalent, then replace only that interpretation. Never revise supplied facts; omit the device if no honest correction fits.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: routine-terrible
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If a severe supplied fact fits, state it once in the flat voice used for chores. Add no timing, circumstance, or consequence; otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: household-maintenance
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If supplied facts include a cleanup, repair, treatment, or burial task, close once by treating that task as ordinary maintenance. Never invent a task; otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: unacknowledged-dark
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If one supplied detail is dark, state it plainly once without reacting to it. Never add a darker detail; otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: dry-tally-of-loss
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Name only supplied people or things that were lost, once, in a flat clerical tone inside normal sentences. If no loss is supplied, omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: grim-understatement
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Use one calm understatement to reduce the narrator's reaction, never the scale or truth of supplied facts. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: matter-of-fact-mortality
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Only if supplied facts mention death or injury, mention it once in a matter-of-fact tone and move straight on. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: queued-for-later
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If supplied facts include unresolved aftermath or a named task, refer once to addressing it later. Never invent an obligation or timing; otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: professional-detachment
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Describe only supplied aftermath facts once in the detached tone of a routine work report. If no aftermath is supplied, omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: grim-practicality
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If supplied facts name a practical next task, pivot to it once as if the event were settled. Never invent a task or outcome; otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: even-measure
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Only if supplied facts include both a serious loss and a trivial gain, set them together once and call it even in one flat sentence. Otherwise omit this device.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: could-have-been-worse
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Use "Could have been worse" once as defensive understatement. Never invent or imply an unsupplied worse event; omit the device if it would distort the supplied facts.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: enough-for-now
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Close once with "That is enough for now" or a natural equivalent, and add nothing after it. Omit the device if the ending conflicts with the writing style or tone.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: not-writing-that-down
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: Briefly refuse once to write down one feeling named in the supplied context, while still stating the supplied event facts. Omit the device if no feeling is supplied.

PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.label: old-words-return
PawnDiary.DiaryHumorCueDef.rule: If a previous ending is supplied, echo once one ordinary word or short phrase from it with changed emotional weight. Never retell it; otherwise omit this device.
